title: Abba Chagrat
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Derekh Eretz Rabbah, chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tractate_Derekh_Eretz_Rabbah.1.13): Abba Chalfi says in the name of his father, Abba Chagrat: “Do not be reckless with vows, lest you violate oaths; do not linger with an ignorant priest; and do not converse excessively with a woman.” (A related anonymous teaching appears in [Nedarim](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.20a.10).) [Shabbat 105b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.105b.8) has Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar speaking in the name of Chilfa bar Agra. It appears that he is Abba Chagrat: aleph interchanges with chet in the Jerusalem Talmud, as in Ilfa–Chilfa.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Derekh Eretz has Abba Chalfi speak in his father’s name and warns against staying as the priest’s guest. Nedarim gives a related anonymous teaching. The link to Shabbat and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1324&lang=en) give Chilfa bar Agra reporting Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri. Hyman suggests the identification with Abba Chagrat.
